title: Oil companies step up petrol pump toilet checks to improve customer service
description:
Clean toilets at petrol pumps may seem like a small amenity, but oil marketing companies are seeking to make them a visible measure of customer service, with senior executives personally leading inspections of washrooms across the country and QR codes inviting travellers to rate their experience.
Under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas' Swachhata Abhiyan, public-sector oil marketing companies are stepping up checks and maintenance of toilets at retail fuel outlets, seeking to turn a cleanliness drive into a lasting customer-service commitment rather than a temporary campaign.
The message is increasingly coming from the top. Directors (Marketing) of Indian Oil Corporation Ltd (IndianOil) and Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) have taken to inspecting outlets themselves, spotlighting clean facilities and reinforcing the expectation that hygienic washrooms should be part of the service motorists can count on when they pull into a petrol pump.
